question: I won a trip for four to the Super Bowl.  I can bring three of my friends.  I have 8 friends.  In how many ways can I form my Super Bowl party?
solution:
My spot is fixed, so I only need to choose three of my eight friends. There are 8 × 7 × 6 ways to pick three friends in order. Each group is counted 3 × 2 × 1 = 6 times, once for each ordering. Thus there are (8 × 7 × 6)/6 = 56 groups.
Final answer: 56
